<h1 class="profile-name">Elvis Kwame Ofori</h1>

<div class="profile-role">Agricultural, land-use and policy modeller</div>

<p class="profile-lead"><strong>National climate and land-use targets are set in aggregate, but their costs, opportunities and constraints fall on particular farms, production systems and places.</strong> My research measures that incidence and tests how policy design changes who adjusts, where, and at what cost.</p>

<section class="home-section">

<div class="section-heading">
<h2>Research question</h2>
<a href="research/">Research statement →</a>
</div>

<p class="home-statement">How can national agricultural, climate and land-use objectives be translated into evidence about the farms, production systems and places that will actually carry the transition? I use spatial modelling, econometrics, microsimulation and optimisation to connect national pathways with local incidence and implementation.</p>

</section>

<div class="featured-project">

<div class="featured-project">
<div class="meta">Land-use persistence · United States</div>
<h3><a href="projects/e-seat/">E-SEAT</a></h3>
